WITH media_type_rates AS (
  SELECT m.Name AS media_type_name,
         AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS byte_rate
  FROM MediaType AS m
  JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY m.Name
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS avg_byte_rate
  FROM media_type_rates
)
SELECT r.media_type_name,
       r.byte_rate,
       r.byte_rate - a.avg_byte_rate AS above_overall_average
FROM media_type_rates AS r
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS a
WHERE r.byte_rate > a.avg_byte_rate;
